prediction_metrics.command_definition: box-clipped nominal 17D velocity minus actually consumed selected 17D command

C00.qp_solve_scope: One original 17D solve call per planner invocation; rejected result calls count; raised calls remain separate. Logging adds no alternative solver.
C00.geometry_query_scope: Native mj_geomDistance calls, separated by phase; analytic PCC query work is reported by the original interval evidence, not mislabeled as native distance calls.
C00.instrumentation: Transparent argument/return/exception forwarding; additional Python bookkeeping included in wall time.
C00.physics_step_count_scope: Successfully returned mj_step or mj_step2 integrations; raised calls reported separately without assuming how far a native failure progressed.
